name: US5513929A Fixed offshore platform structures, using small diameter, tensioned, well casing tiebacks
notes: Patent read in the WHP sweep: Fixed offshore platform structures, using small diameter, tensioned, well casing tiebacks; assignee McDermott International Inc; Published 1996-05-07, filed 1994-08-11; expired.
